claims.claim: It serves as a stacking base.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show stacks of wooden pallets arranged in rows, consistent with use as a stacking base.

claims.claim: Available for pickup only in Port Harcourt.
claims.evidence: Witness report contains no location/availability details beyond the photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear/dirt on used pallets; dryness/cleanliness claims are not fully verifiable from the provided angles.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale readout, certificate, or weighing clip is shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Lot quantity/weight may differ from the stated total (e.g., fewer pallets than implied by the stated weight).
risks.proof: A clear video/clip showing the pallets being weighed on the certified scale, with the scale reading visible and the pallet count visible before/after.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-quantity used pallet lot (worst case: smaller quantity than claimed).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than expected (broken boards, missing nails/fasteners, heavy warping, or damaged corner blocks).
risks.proof: One full set of close-up shots of the corners and underside of multiple pallets (including the most damaged-looking ones), showing any cracks/breaks and missing fasteners.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets with possible damage (worst case: some pallets not serviceable for heavy loads).

risks.risk: Treatment/standard compliance may be unclear (EPAL stamp alone may not confirm heat-treatment/chemical treatment status for export or compliance needs).
risks.proof: Photos of the full treatment stamp/markings on multiple pallets (including any additional codes beyond “EPAL”), taken close enough to read.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified compliance pallets (worst case: treated status not confirmed).

risks.risk: Moisture/rot/infestation risk (odor, dampness, or pest damage) cannot be confirmed from the photos.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the pallets being inspected for moisture/odor (seller opens/turns a few pallets to show inner boards) plus close-ups of any suspicious dark/soft wood areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damp/used pallets (worst case: discount for possible moisture-related issues).

risks.risk: Exact pallet dimensions may not match standard sizes, affecting stacking efficiency and buyer use.
risks.proof: A measuring shot showing length/width/height on at least one pallet (tape measure visible) and comparison to standard EPAL dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown dimensions (worst case: non-standard size reduces usability).

proof_requests: Send a clear video of the weighing process with the certified scale reading visible and the pallet lot shown during weighing.
Provide close-up photos of the most damaged pallets: corners, underside, and any cracked/broken slats (include at least several pallets across the stack).
Show treatment/compliance markings beyond the “EPAL” stamp (full stamp area) on multiple pallets, taken close enough to read.
Provide a short inspection clip for moisture/odor and any signs of rot or pests (turn a few pallets to show inner boards).
Provide one measuring photo with tape measure showing pallet length/width/height on at least one pallet.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as used EPAL-stamped wooden pallets in a stacked lot, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, key details (exact count/weight, condition severity, treatment compliance, and moisture/infestation) are not fully verifiable from the photos, so the price should assume the worst until proof is provided.
